• 
Supervise the daily service and FoH team in the restaurant

• 
Control and direct the drink preparation process and ordering, and any other activities in relation here to

• 
Ensure quality of the servings by controlling drinks and dishes before they reach the guest

•

Remedy any problems or defects and arrange for repairs with suppliers when necessary

Plan and fill in the work schedule and approve hours

Oversee the work of your team and estimate your teams’ workload

•

• 
Foster a work climate of cooperation and respect between members of the team

• 
Work hours are mainly in the evenings and weekends

If you're a hospitality rockstar with a knack for cracking jokes and mixing drinks, we want to raise a glass with you at Mæxico Venues. Come join our team where we value teamwork, creativity, and serving up smiles along with our signature cocktails!

We Offer:

- A leadership role in a dynamic and creative setting.

- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.

- Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.

- Staff meals and generous dining discounts at Chow Co restaurants.

• 
Experience in culinary industry - Must have

• 
Commitment for the next 12 months - Must have

• 
Excellent customer service skills

• 
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

• 
Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• 
Attention to detail and accuracy

• 
Ability to work well in a team

• 
Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays

• 
Experience in budget & KPI management

We seek professionals who are passionate about the intersection of technology and finance. If you enjoy solving complex challenges and creating value for clients, and have specific experience with OneStream, AMCO Solutions offers an ideal environment for you to thrive. Experience in other CPM software solutions is also a relevant background.

Job Description

As a Senior Consultant, your responsibilities will include:

•   Engaging in all phases of the project lifecycle, from gathering requirements to building solutions and supporting client’s post-launch.

•   Collaborating with a skilled, diverse team to address challenging business needs and deliver effective solutions, ensuring OneStream is utilized to its full

•   potential.

•   Leading project tasks and ensuring timely, high-quality delivery in accordance with project scope.

•   Mentoring and coaching colleagues while contributing to the overall knowledge-sharing within the team.

•   Actively participating in internal initiatives to help AMCO maintain its position as a leader in implementation of OneStream solutions.

Requirements and Qualifications

•   A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in economics, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

•   3-4 years of CPM implementation experience, including system design, project management, and change management. Specific knowledge of OneStream

•   Software is an advantage.

•   A solid understanding of accounting & finance principles (preferred).

•   OneStream certification is a strong plus, and experience with the software is highly preferred for this role.

Perks and Benefits

•   Professional Development: Access to training and certifications in OneStream, and continuous learning opportunities.

•   Work-Life Balance: Flexibility in working hours and the opportunity to collaborate with a global team across various time zones.

•   Competitive Compensation: We offer a competitive salary package, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career advancement.

Do you get a small, slightly nerdy kick out of working out why a conversion stopped firing three weeks ago and nobody noticed?

At Helion B2B we don't just "run ads" for our clients. We build data-driven growth engines for some of the most ambitious B2B companies in Europe. But an engine is only as good as its sensors. That's where you come in.

You won't just keep the engine running. You'll help build it.

You'll join our tracking team in Aarhus, working day to day with our Tracking Lead. Real ownership early, someone who has done all of it sitting right next to you, and a direct hand in how the practice develops. We have standards, and we like them being challenged. If you think we're doing something the hard way, we'd rather hear it in week two than in year two.

You'll work across all of it: new implementations, server-side setups, multi-market containers, consent, QA, troubleshooting, and the measurement plans that hold it together. Real clients, and real responsibility for whether their measurement holds up.

Some of that is building something new. A lot of it is taking a setup that already exists and making it better than you found it, which is where data quality actually comes from. Your scope over the clients you look after grows from there.

The job doesn't stop when the data arrives. Part of the work is reporting and analysis: helping a client see what their numbers are telling them, and noticing when a number is telling them something wrong. Mostly technical work, then, but not only

Your playground

• 
Google Tag Manager: Web containers from day one, server-side (sGTM) as you grow into it.

• 
GA4: Event design, debugging, and making sure the numbers actually mean something.

• 
HubSpot: we're an Elite HubSpot partner, so tracking data and CRM data have to meet properly.

• 
Consent management: Cookiebot and Cookie Information, Consent Mode, and the GDPR reality behind them.

• 
Data Studio and reporting: Turning all of the above into something a client can read and act on, and being able to say what it means.

• 
AI-assisted tracking: We're actively building agent-supported auditing, monitoring and insight workflows. You'll use them, break them, and help shape where they go next.

What you need on day one

• 
You can build and debug tags, triggers and variables in a web GTM container on your own. Preview mode and Tag Assistant are familiar territory.

• 
You can configure and debug GA4, and you know what to start checking when a dimension comes back as (not set).

• 
You're a finisher. "Done" means tested and verified, not deployed.

• 
You think for yourself. When you hit a wall, you research, test and come back with a proposal rather than waiting for instructions.

• 
You're curious about where AI is taking this field. You don't need experience with it. You need to want to poke at it.

Somewhere around three to five years of hands-on tracking experience, from an agency or in-house, is the usual shape. It's a guide, not a gate.

What you'll learn here

Server-side GTM and Conversions API. Consent Mode in depth. HubSpot data flows. BigQuery. Multi-market container architecture. Reporting and analysis on top of GA4 and BigQuery. B2B lead cycles, and why they make tracking a harder problem than e-commerce.

Experience with any of these is an advantage. None of them are requirements. You'll have a lead who would rather teach you properly than do it twice.

The practical bits

• 
Where: Our Aarhus office, with a minimum of three days a week on site.

• 
Language: We work in English. Danish is an advantage, not a requirement.

• 
Right to work: You must already hold the right to work in Denmark: EU/EEA citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit.

• 
Everyday life: Lunch scheme and flexible hours. We care that the work lands, not that you were at your desk at 08:30.

• 
Pension and insurance: Company-paid pension and health insurance (sundhedsforsikring).

• 
Growing here: We back training and certifications, and you'll have a lead who would rather you learned something new than closed one more ticket.

• 
The social side: fredagsbar, summer party, julefrokost and a yearly off-site. If you're new to Denmark, ask about the julefrokost.

> Earlier in your career than the above, but the rest of this sounds like you? Apply anyway and tell us where you're at. We'd rather shape the level around the right person than miss them.

Business-to-business, person-to-person

Helion B2B is a fast-growing, Elite HubSpot partner that helps B2B companies build growth engines.

We are an ambitious, curious team genuinely passionate about our work. We are eager to learn, value great social relationships and are not afraid of challenging ourselves and our clients if we feel that there is a better way to solve a challenge.

You can read more about us, our customers and what we do on helionb2b.com or on our HubSpot Directory page.

Let's talk business-to-business, person-to-person

For more information or questions please contact us at job@helionb2b.com

jobs.occupation: Site Manager Isolering Danmark (m/k/d) - Site Manager Insulation - Site Manager Isolierung – Dänemark (m/w/d) Denmark (m/f/d) -
jobs.description:
See desription in English below

Siehe Beschreibung auf Deutsch unten

Dansk:

TL Concept er en veletableret produktions- og entreprenørvirksomhed, der er specialiseret i teknisk isolering, pladekapper, ventilationskanaler og brandbeskyttelse. Med mange års erfaring og ca. 600 dygtige medarbejdere, leverer vi løsninger af høj tysk kvalitet til byggeprojekter i hele Europa. TL Concept oplever stærk vækst, og Danmark er et af vores strategiske vækstområder. Vi har etableret et dansk selskab med dansk ledelse. www.tlconcept.eu      

 

Vi er kendt for vores fokus på innovation, præcision og en kundecentreret tilgang. Vores mål er at skabe bæredygtige og effektive løsninger, der lever op til vores kunders krav om kvalitet, samtidig med at vi sikrer et sikkert og inspirerende arbejdsmiljø for vores medarbejdere. Hos TL Concept er vi stolte af vores stærke teamkultur, hvor samarbejde og udvikling er i centrum. Vi tror på, at motiverede medarbejdere skaber de bedste resultater, og derfor prioriterer vi uddannelse og personlig udvikling.

 

Vi søger en engageret Site Manager Isolering til vores team. Hos os får du mulighed for spille en nøglerolle i store byggeprojekter, der involverer teknisk isolering, pladebeklædning, ventilationskanaler og passiv brandbeskyttelse

 

Som Site Manager bliver du ansvarlig for at drive vores byggeprojekter fremad. Du kommer til at spille en central rolle i at sikre udførelse af høj kvalitet, effektiv projektstyring og sikkerhed på byggepladsen. Du arbejder tæt sammen med et team på ca. 15 isolatører og montører, og din arbejdsdag vil være præget af ansvar og variation.

 

VI TILBYDER

·   Et ansvarsfuldt og afvekslende job i en dynamisk virksomhed med vindermentalitet

·   Ansættelse efter dansk lov i dansk datterselskab

·   Ægte holdånd, åben kommunikation og uformel arbejdsatmosfære

·   Professionelle processer og korte beslutningsveje

·   Firmabil og firmabetalt mobiltelefon

·   Løn efter kvalifikationer og mulighed for sundhedsforsikring

·   Løbende videreuddannelse og spændende projekter

 

FAGLIGE OG PERSONLIGE FORUDSÆTNINGER

·   Flere års erfaring som Site Manager inden for byggeledelse

·   Erfaring med montering – særligt af teknisk isolering, og gerne pladekapper, ventilation og brandbeskyttelse

·   Serviceorienteret, pålidelig og i stand til at motivere både sig selv og medarbejdere

·   Ansvarlig og kvalitetsbevidst , loyal, ærlig og vindende personlighed

·   Villig til at rejse til aktuelle byggeprojekter i Danmark (vi har aktuelt projekter på Sjælland 1 år frem)

·   Taler min. et af de skandinaviske sprog og engelsk. Kan du tysk er det et plus, men ikke et krav

·   Arbejdstilladelse i EU samt kørekort (kategori B)

·   Erfaren bruger af Office-pakken

 

DINE OPGAVER

·   Byggeledelse: Herunder koordinering af projekter og deadlines, ordrebehandling og materialeplanlægning, fakturerings- og økonomisk ansvar og daglig overblik over montagepersonale

·   Arbejdsmiljø og sikkerhed: Herunder sikre orden og sikkerhed på byggepladserne, overholde arbejdsmiljøregler og koordinere ferieplanlægning

·   Uddannelse og vejledning: Herunder uddanne, evaluere og udvikle teknisk personale i samarbejde med Projektlederen

·   Kvalitet og kommunikation: Herunder løbende overvågning og forbedring af kvalitet og produktivitet samt sikre god kommunikation og støtte til kunder og projektleder

Send dit fyldestgørende ansøgningsmateriale på dansk engelsk eller tysk per e-mail, inklusive cv, lønforventning og tilgængelighed, til Jørgen Villadsen: jorgen.villadsen@tlconcept.eu

 

For spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte Jørgen per e-mail.

 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

English:

TL Concept is a well-established manufacturing and contracting company specialising in technical insulation, sheet metal cladding, ventilation ducts and fire protection. With many years of experience and approx. 600 skilled employees, we deliver solutions of high German quality to construction projects throughout Europe. TL Concept is experiencing strong growth, and Denmark is one of our strategic growth areas. We have established a Danish company with Danish management. www.tlconcept.eu 

We are known for our focus on innovation, precision and a customer-centric approach. Our goal is to create sustainable and efficient solutions that fulfil our customers' demands for quality while ensuring a safe and inspiring work environment for our employees. At TL Concept, we are proud of our strong team culture, where collaboration and development take centre stage. We believe that motivated employees create the best results, which is why we prioritise training and personal development.

We are looking for a dedicated Site Manager Insulation to join our team. With us, you will have the opportunity to play a key role in large construction projects involving technical insulation, cladding, ventilation ducts and passive fire protection

As a Site Manager, you will be responsible for driving our construction projects forward. You will play a key role in ensuring high-quality execution, efficient project management and safety on site. Working closely with a team of around 15 insulators and fitters, your working day will be characterised by responsibility and variety.

WE OFFER

·   A responsible and varied job in a dynamic company with a winning mentality

·   Employment under Danish law in a Danish subsidiary

·   True team spirit, open communication and an informal working atmosphere

·   Professional processes and short decision-making processes

·   Company car and company-paid mobile phone.

·   Salary according to qualifications and the option of health insurance

·   Continuous training and exciting projects

 

PROFESSIONAL & PERSONAL PREREQUISITES

·   Several years of experience as a Site Manager in construction management

·   Experience in installation - especially technical insulation, and preferably sheet metal cladding, ventilation and fire protection

·   Service-orientated, reliable and able to motivate yourself and staff

·   Responsible and quality-conscious, loyal, honest and winning personality

·   Willing to travel to current construction projects in Denmark (we currently have projects on Zealand 1 year ahead)

·   Speaks min. one of the Scandinavian languages and English. German is a plus, but not a requirement

·   EU work permit and driving licence (category B)

·   Experienced user of Microsoft (Office, Excel, PowerPoint e.g.)

 

YOUR TASKS

·   Construction management: incl. coordination of projects and deadlines, order processing and material planning, invoicing and financial responsibility and daily overview of assembly staff

·   Health & safety: Incl. ensuring order and safety on construction sites, complying with health and safety regulations and coordinating holiday planning

·   Education & supervision: Incl. training, evaluating and developing technical staff in co-operation with the Project Manager

·   Quality & communication: Incl. continuous monitoring and improvement of quality and productivity as well as ensuring good communication and support to customers and project manager

Send your complete application material in Danish, English or German by email, including CV, salary expectations and availability, to Jørgen Villadsen: jorgen.villadsen@tlconcept.eu 

For questions, you are welcome to contact Jørgen by e-mail.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Deutsch:

TL Concept ist ein etabliertes Produktions- und Bauunternehmen, das sich auf technische Isolierungen, Blechverkleidungen, Lüftungskanäle und Brandschutz spezialisiert hat. Mit langjähriger Erfahrung und ca. 600 qualifizierten Mitarbeitern liefern wir Lösungen von hoher deutscher Qualität für Bauprojekte in ganz Europa. Unser Ziel ist es, nachhaltige und effiziente Lösungen zu schaffen, die die Qualitätsanforderungen unserer Kunden erfüllen und gleichzeitig ein sicheres und inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld für unsere Mitarbeiter gewährleisten. WIR BIETEN

·   Professionelle Prozesse und kurze Entscheidungswege

·   Firmenwagen und ein vom Unternehmen bezahltes Mobiltelefon.

·   Ein Gehalt, das der Qualifikation entspricht, und die Möglichkeit einer Krankenversicherung

·   Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und spannende Projekte

 

FACHLICHE & PERSÖNLICHE VORAUSSETZUNGEN

·   Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Bauleiter im Baumanagement

·   Erfahrung im Montagebereich - insbesondere technische Isolierung, vorzugsweise Blechverkleidung, Lüftung und Brandschutz

IHRE AUFGABEN

·   Baumanagement: inkl. Projekt- und Terminkoordination, Auftragsabwicklung und Materialdisposition, Rechnungsstellung und Finanzverantwortung sowie täglicher Überblick über das Montagepersonal

·   Gesundheit & Sicherheit: Inkl. Sicherstellung von Ordnung und Sicherheit auf den Baustellen, Einhaltung der Arbeitsschutzbestimmungen und Koordination der Urlaubsplanung

Senden Sie Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen in Dänisch, Englisch oder Deutsch per E-Mail mit Lebenslauf, Gehaltsvorstellungen und Verfügbarkeit an Jørgen Villadsen: jorgen.villadsen@tlconcept.eu .

Kort beskrivelse

Support a 9-year-old boy in Skævinge

Jobbeskrivelse

Do you have experience working with children with special needs, and do you enjoy an active one-to-one role? Then you could become an important source of support for a 9-year-old boy who loves movement, play and safe, predictable routines.

About the role

You will provide regular one-to-one support for a 9-year-old boy with autism and an intellectual disability. He needs close support, clear structure and a calm approach that helps create predictability.

The boy is energetic, enjoys being active and particularly likes outdoor play, trips to the playground and running in the woods. He also enjoys activities such as puzzles, music, bubbles, balloons and sensory toys. Your role is to plan and take part in activities that match his pace and needs. As he has limited awareness of danger, it is important that you stay close to him and remain attentive to his surroundings.

The role includes assistance with personal care, including bathing, changing diapers and toilet training. You will also provide support at mealtimes, with a focus on motivating and guiding him towards gradually becoming more independent.

The boy does not communicate verbally and uses only a few English words. It is therefore important that you are able to communicate in English, including with his parents, who do not speak Danish.

The boy has food allergies and has an EpiPen, which must be used in the event of an allergic reaction. The family will provide thorough instructions on its use. He also has asthma, and his parents are responsible for all medication management.

About you

You may be a qualified pedagogue/social educator or have relevant experience working with children with special needs. You approach the child with calmness, patience and clarity, and you enjoy an active working environment where you take part in play and physical activities.

At the same time, you are able to create structure and a sense of security, be attentive and provide clear boundaries when needed. As communication with the family takes place in English, you must be able to communicate confidently in English.

A driving licence is an advantage. Alternatively, you must be comfortable using the family’s cargo bike, which will be provided.

Working hours

The position is for 16 hours per week. The working hours are:

Two weekdays per week: 3 hours after school, from 2:30 pm to 5:30 pm

Thursdays: 9:30 am to 1:30 pm (4 hours)

Sundays: 11:00 am to 5:00 pm

What we offer

You will become part of a family-owned company with many dedicated employees. You will have a dedicated adviser who is available for guidance and support. Outside office hours, a staffed emergency phone line is always available, so you are never on your own.

Salary and pension are provided in accordance with the national collective agreement between FOA and the Danish Chamber of Commerce (Dansk Erhverv). You are covered by DUOS’ liability and occupational injury insurance, and health insurance is included as part of your pension scheme.

We offer a wide range of courses, and as a DUOS employee, you will receive relevant induction and ongoing professional development. Working with people at DUOS also gives you the opportunity to develop both personally and professionally.

Would you like to become our new colleague?

Please submit your application via the link. You must have a profile on mit.duos.dk and be logged in to apply. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. The position is available for an immediate start.

If you have any further questions, please contact Recruitment Consultant Trine Ankær Johansen on +45 36 34 49 90. You can also find answers to general questions in our FAQ.

We are people helping people

At DUOS, we help people in their everyday lives, support them through challenging situations and contribute to their well-being and quality of life. As one of Denmark’s largest and longest-established welfare service providers, we strive to be there where support is needed.

We understand the importance of combining empathy with the right professional expertise, and we know that finding the right match between an employee and the person receiving support is essential for our services to make a meaningful difference.

Join the DUOS team and make an important difference in another person’s life.

Learn more about DUOS at www.duos.dk.

experience in the industry, we have built strong, long-term relationships with customers across most of
Denmark. Our projects range from multi-story buildings and private homes to high-end properties involving

We are looking for experienced and reliable aerated concrete installers to join our growing team. If you

·         Have a valid driving license

·         Be an EU/EEA citizen or already hold a valid Danish work permit

You are offered: Pension, health insurance and work clothes

Start date: As soon as possible

Type of contract: Permanent employment

Contact: For questions about the position, please contact the company owner, Erlan, on +45 42 80 50 30.

How to apply: Please send your CV and application to info@laudalhansen.dk

**About Bolt

**Bolt is shaping a future where cities are built for people, not cars. What started as an ambitious project of a 19-year-old in 2013 has grown into a global mobility platform used by more than 200 million customers and 4.5 million driver and courier partners across 50 countries.

From ride-hailing and food delivery to scooters, e-bikes, and car-sharing, Bolt helps people move through cities every day. Small, autonomous teams drive this work, combining the speed and ownership of a startup with the scale of a global technology company backed by more than €1bn in funding.

And we're just getting started.

**Why join Bolt?

**

• Build the future of mobility and help transform how people live and move in cities.

• Tackle challenges at scale that span technology, operations, regulation, and growth.

• Take real ownership early. Small, lean teams mean your decisions matter from day one, and you'll learn fast alongside some of the best people in the industry.

• Join one of Europe's leading technology companies, backed by world-class investors including Sequoia.

**About The Role

**Bolt for Business is scaling fast — and corporate mobility is one of the biggest opportunities ahead of us. As Regional Sales Manager, you'll lead up to 8 country-based sales teams, owning the strategy and execution behind how businesses of all sizes manage employee mobility and ground transportation. This isn't just team management — it's building and scaling a B2B sales engine across multiple markets, with real autonomy to shape how we win.

_Please note that this role can be based in one of the following locations: Denmark, Sweden, Finland, Norway, or Germany.

_**Main Tasks And Responsibilities

**

• Lead across borders. Manage and coach multiple country-based B2B sales teams, building a culture of consistently high performance across your region.

• Own the strategy, not just the execution. Set the go-to-market approach for your region — team structure, pipeline planning, lead allocation, and KPIs built for enterprise sales cycles.

• Drive real revenue growth. Go after high-value corporate accounts that deliver strong ROI and accelerate Bolt for Business's expansion into new markets.

• Build the team you lead. Partner closely with recruitment to hire and develop a high-performing, cross-country B2B sales organization from the ground up.

• Solve problems that matter. Spot what's blocking growth in corporate sales motions, and lead entrepreneurial projects that test new approaches to enterprise acquisition — this is a role for people who like building, not just maintaining.

• Operate at a senior level. Lead key enterprise contract negotiations, deliver accurate forecasts to senior leadership, coach your sales managers, and stay ahead of market and competitor trends in B2B mobility.

**About You

**

• An entrepreneurial mindset — you take ownership, move fast in ambiguity, and are always looking for smarter ways to scale.

• 3+ years leading B2B or enterprise sales teams, with hands-on experience in performance management and coaching.

• 2+ years as an individual contributor in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding targets — ideally in digital marketplaces, mobility, or enterprise services.

• A data-driven approach to pipeline planning, budgeting, and resource allocation across multiple markets.

• Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, managing complex B2B pipelines and tracking team performance.

• Executive-level communication and presentation skills — you're comfortable in the room with senior stakeholders.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Public Sector Management Accounting and Control
jobs.description:
The Department of Accounting invites applications for a PhD position in Public Sector Management Accounting and Control. The Department of Accounting is one of the oldest and largest accounting departments in Europe. We have a growing and flourishing research environment within financial accounting, management accounting and control, auditing, and corporate governance.

Public sector organizations continuously face demands for high service quality under increasingly tighter budget constraints while simultaneously being held accountable for their performance. Several attempts have been made to strengthen management accounting and control practices such as introducing new costing techniques, performance-based budgeting, benchmarking, and performance management. But despite these initiatives, public organizations still struggle to realize political objectives, which is further complicated by the development of new technologies and societal demands for sustainability. Within this context, the PhD application should reflect an independently formulated research project that addresses questions related to the role and effects of management accounting and control practice in public sector organizations at state, regional and/or municipal level. Potential research areas are:

• 
Developing and using performance measurement and management to create public value

• 
The influence of new technologies on management accounting and control practices

• 
The use of financial/non-financial information by public officials and politicians

• 
The development and/or use of budgeting for public sector decision-making

• 
The role of accounting in strategic development and public organization management

The PhD candidate will be part of the department’s management accounting research group. We focus on examining various subjects related to management accounting and control within both private and public sectors. For this PhD position, we welcome all forms of research methodologies and theoretical approaches, but we prioritize research inquiring specifically into organizational practices. We are open to candidates from different academic backgrounds both within and outside business administration.

The candidate will be expected to teach within management and control. As many courses are taught in Danish, priority will be given to candidates with language proficiencies in Danish, Swedish or Norwegian.

About the PhD programme
The three-year PhD programme at CBS gives you the opportunity to conduct research under the supervision of CBS’s associate professors and professors, supported by research related PhD courses. The programme is highly international, and you are expected to participate in international research conferences and to spend time at another research institution as a visiting PhD student. See the CBS homepage for more information about the PhD programme, https://www.cbs.dk/en/research/phd-programmeme. 

CBS PhD graduates are held in high esteem not only in academia and research institutions but also in government and business where their research qualifications are in high demand.

CBS is committed to ensuring excellence, transformative and relevant teaching and research. Candidates who wish to join us must be interested in working in an organisation of this type and it is expected that the applicant will show an interest in joining the department's research environment. You can read more about the department's research here: www.cbs.dk/acc. 

Application and admission requirements
The department will give priority to applicants with high grades from their universities. To be considered the applicant must:

• 
have a basic education at master's level (corresponding to the 3 + 2 Bologna process)

• 
have received the grade of 10 (or equivalent) for the master's thesis according to the Danish 7-point grading scale (https://ufm.dk/en/education/the-danish-education-system/grading-system)

• 
have a weighted grade point average of at least 8.2 on the Danish 7-point grading scale for the bachelor's and master's degree combined or alternatively a weighted grade point average must be at least 9.5 for the master's degree alone. If the grade point average is not met, documentation for being in the top 40% of the class is also accepted. In rare cases, the grade requirement can be waived.

• 
have completed the master's programme before starting the PhD programme at CBS

• 
master academic English at a high level in writing and speaking

The application (see link below) must include a five-page project description. The project description must include:

• 
a presentation of an original research question

• 
a description of the initial theoretical framework and method

• 
a presentation of the proposed empirical material

• 
a work plan for the three years

More information can be found here: https://www.cbs.dk/en/research/phd-programmemes/admission

In addition to the project description, copies of the following must be included:

• 
diploma for bachelor's and master's degree or other certificates at an equivalent level as well as the grade transcripts

• 
documentation for being in the top 40% of the class (if grade requirements are not met)

• 
a concise curriculum vitae (CV)

• 
a list of articles and publications (if applicable)

• 
one example of a selected written work (e.g. master's thesis)

The PhD student is enrolled in the CBS PhD School. Further information about PhD scholarships and the PhD programme can be found at https://www.cbs.dk/en/research/phd-programmeme.

Information about the department can be found at https://www.cbs.dk/forskning/institutter-centre/institut-regnskab.

For additional information regarding the PhD position, feel free to contact Associate Professor, Tim Neerup Themsen, tnt.acc@cbs.dk.

Employment and salary
A PhD scholarship runs for a period of three years and includes teaching obligations corresponding to 416 work hours. The scholarships are fully salaried positions, according to the national Danish collective agreement. The monthly salary is currently approximately DKK 30,264 up to DKK 36,877 depending on seniority and a pension contribution totaling 18.07%. The scholarship includes tuition fees, office space, course and travel costs (according to the current CBS agreement). 

Salary level and employment take place in accordance with the Ministry of Finance's agreement with the Academics' Central Organization.

Recruitment procedure
The Recruitment Committee shortlists at least two-five applicants to be assessed by the Assessment Committee. Applicants are informed whether their application has proceeded for assessment.

Applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and will receive their personal assessment later. Selected applicants will be invited for an interview. Please note that a positive assessment does not automatically result in an interview. Once the recruitment process is completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application. 

The application must be sent via the online link below. 

Copenhagen Business School must receive all application material, including all appendices (see above), by the application deadline.

Details about Copenhagen Business School are available at www.cbs.dk/en.

Application due 11/11/2026

jobs.description:
PhD Position in Computational Mass Spectrometry Imaging and Spatial Metabolomics
Applications are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at the Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Roskilde Campus, Denmark, within the Environmental Science and Toxicology department. The position is available from February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Title
PhD Position in Computational Mass Spectrometry Imaging and Spatial Metabolomics

Research area and project description
Spatial metabolomics enables the study of biochemical processes and human–environment interactions at micrometer to cellular resolution (single cell metabolomics). Mass spectrometry imaging (MSI) is increasingly used to investigate how environmental stressors and micropollutants affect biological systems across space and time. However, data processing, image segmentation, multimodal image registration, reproducible computational workflows and biological interpretation remain major challenges.

This project will develop computational methods and open-source tools for processing, analyzing and interpreting MSI and spatial metabolomics data. The methods will be applied to microbial communities, environmental samples and tissues to uncover spatially resolved biotransformation processes and metabolic responses to environmental stressors.

The successful candidate will work at the interface of computational science, biochemistry, microbiology and analytical chemistry. The project will combine computational method development with experimental spatial metabolomics including signal preprocessing, machine learning, spatial statistics, image registration and interactive software development. The PhD student will join an interdisciplinary team of chemists, microbiologists, biologists and computational scientists and contribute to both methodological development and biological applications.

The position includes:
• Developing batch-processing workflows for MSI and metabolomics data, including normalization, quantification and feature alignment.
• Developing spatial segmentation methods, including uncertainty-aware and spatially regularized clustering.
• Collaborating with experimental scientists, mass spectrometrists and biologists to validate methods against experimental and biological datasets. Ensure reliable implementation of automated quality control, testing, documentation and reproducibility reporting.
• Communicating computational results clearly to interdisciplinary and non-computational re-searchers. Processing and analyzing imaging datasets and presenting results at internal and international scientific meetings.
• Publishing methodological and application studies and releasing well-documented open-source software.
• Close supervision and collaboration with dedicated researchers and senior investigators.
Project description

Qualifications and specific competences
We are seeking highly motivated candidates with a strong interest in interdisciplinary research. Applicants should hold a master’s degree (or equivalent) in computer science, bioinformatics/ cheminformatics, AI/ML, data science, chemistry, computational biology, chemometrics, analytical chemistry or a related discipline.

Essential qualifications:
• Solid background in computational chemistry, image processing, omics data analysis and/or mass spectrometry
• Strong interest in spatial metabolomics and its applicationsDesirable qualifications:
• Experience with mass spectrometry, microscopy, microbial systems, or analytical chemistry
• Ability to work independently as well as in collaborative, interdisciplinary teams
